title: Health Effects of Cetoleic Acid (A Randomized Double Blinded Controlled Trial)

sections.abstract: In this Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) we want to study how supplements of cetoleic acid ( C22:n1-11) (intervention) affect the conversion of alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) to EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) and DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) in healthy subjects, compared to supplements with a low concentration of cetoleic acid (control). Our primary endpoints are changes in the concentration of EPA and DHA in plasma and red blood cells.
